LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_saveOnly: Saved with this game. Extract items before disabling or removing Phinix.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_groupHint: Expand to withdraw individual records or set a daily plan. Durability, rot and special states remain separate; locked quantities are excluded from the available total.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_extractWholeStackTitle: Extract “{0}”: {1} stacks available, {2} items per stack. Enter stacks.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_transferPending: {0} sends are awaiting confirmation. Their items remain locked.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_empty: Your inventory is empty.\nChoose “Store in inventory” to keep incoming trade and red-packet items here.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_extractInvalid: Enter an integer greater than zero.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_extractExceedsBalance: Only {0} item(s) are available in this inventory entry.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planInvalid: Enter a valid quantity and game time; the quantity cannot exceed the current balance.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_recoveryWarning: Local inventory records are newer than this save. Confirm that they belong to this game. Phinix will not merge them automatically, which prevents duplicate items.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_recoverFailed: Recovery failed; inventory remains read only.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_operationFailed: The inventory change could not be saved.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_pendingWarning: The previous extraction stopped before delivery could be confirmed. Check the map for its drop pod, then choose the matching result. Inventory remains locked until you confirm.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliveryChoiceText: Choose how to receive trade and red-packet items.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliveryChoiceIntro: When trade or red-packet items arrive, Phinix can drop them onto a map immediately or hold them safely in this save.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliveryChoiceFooter: This choice is shared across saves and can be changed at any time in Phinix settings. Inventory contents remain with the current save; extract them before disabling or removing Phinix.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliveryDirectDesc: Create a drop pod as soon as receipt is confirmed. Items are not deducted while a gravship is in flight or no safe landing cell is available.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliveryInventoryDesc: Keep incoming items in this save's Item inventory, then choose how many to extract and when. Useful when no safe landing site is available.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_deliverySettingDesc: This global choice is shared across saves and takes effect immediately. Talent trading remains independent.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchInvalid: Selection changed, invalid count, or another batch is running. Select again.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchStopped: Remaining extraction stopped. Delivered items are kept.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchChanged: Save, delivery map or inventory changed. Remaining extraction stopped.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchRecords: Records per batch (all available units from each record)
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchSelection: {0} available records in this group; individual states are preserved.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchConfirm: Extract all available items from {0} records, one legal stack per frame. Closing the view does not stop it. Failure stops remaining work; delivered items stay delivered and untouched records stay in inventory.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchPerformance: Large batches can cause stalls during restoration, delivery and journal writes, and may take time. Complex modded items can also be slow per stack. Consider a smaller batch first.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_batchRunning: Delivering one stack per frame. You may close the view or stop remaining work.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_searchSelectionHidden: The item being edited is outside these search results.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_searchGroupCleared: Search changed. The group selection was cleared; select a group again for batch extraction.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_inlineReview: Delivery needed reconciliation. Check the delivered amount, then edit the remaining quantity before extracting again.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_inlinePartial: Confirmed delivered: {0} of {1} items. Only the undelivered quantity remains in the field. {2}
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_inlineUnitChanged: The extraction unit changed. Review the unit size, then edit the quantity before extracting.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_inlineUncertainPartial: Confirmed delivered: {0} of {1} items. The rest needs reconciliation; no automatic retry. {2}
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_inlineUnavailable: No quantity is currently available to extract.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_plansEmpty: No daily plans yet. Click an inventory item name to create one.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_plansRemoveConfirm: Remove this daily plan? Items already extracted will not be changed.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_plansBlocked: Inventory reconciliation or batch extraction is in progress. Plans are temporarily read only.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planMissingItem: The inventory record is no longer available.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planRemaining: {0} items still due in this run
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planCodecMissing: The plugin for this item is not active. Enable its source plugin and restart the game.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planCodecVersion: The source plugin cannot read this inventory record version. Use a compatible plugin version.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planItemUnreadable: The source plugin could not read this item. Keep the save and report this error with the game log.
LanguageData.Phinix_inventory_planSaveFailed: The plan could not be saved. Keep this window open and check the inventory status.
